name: World Liberty Financial USD
oneLiner: USD1 is World Liberty Financial's Trump-affiliated dollar stablecoin, issued 1:1 via BitGo Trust against short-term Treasuries, MMFs, and cash deposits.
collateral: Short-term U.S. government Treasury bills, U.S. dollar deposits, and other cash equivalents held for USD1 holders by BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption through BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A.; direct redemption is restricted to registered clients in Good Standing, while holders without a BitGo account rely on secondary markets
